# Actual outer Fourier request

Status: implemented and proved as an acceptance component on 2026-09-29.

This bounded continuation binds the existing shared QFT producer's actual entry
to an independently supplied positive-sign, little-endian Fourier width and
complete interface. The desired sized `.qli` programs and concrete shared IR
producer are preserved by the preceding shared-QPE/QFT authoring packets.

Require the actual entry's first child to compute identity routing, its second
child to pass the complete recursive Fourier-body inspector, and its remaining
children together to compute bit reversal. Obtain every route from actual bodies
using a fresh cache. Share the remaining structural budget after complete
artifact checking; retain full-byte Hadamard obligations and resource typing.
Prove coefficients of the actual whole circuit equal the independently defined
Fourier matrix, including arbitrary reference-entangled amplitudes.

Validate native widths 1–8, changed requested width/interface, omitted or wrong
prefix/suffix, reversed polarity/phase, missing dependencies, exact/one-short
budgets and changed finite H bytes. No external schema is enabled by a component
theorem; production transport, request seals and finite-reader correspondence
remain separate gates. Preserve first sources and actual diagnostics.

The [native record](fourier-root-native.json) passes 74 outcomes, 40 fresh exact-H
reconstructions and 70 complex/reference vectors. Cumulative width-eight work is
1,933,823 of 2,000,000 structural units. The [registry record](fourier-root-registry.json)
and [runtime policy record](fourier-root-runtime-validation.json) retain rebuilt
checks; [first attempts](fourier-root-first/README.md) preserve actual repairs.
